erratas.body: Stamina increased from 5 to 6 on Injured side.
Kinetic Ace is now of type Energy instead of Physical
The power cost of 52 Card Pickup decreases from 4 to 3. The attack loses its trigger that makes |!wild| count as 2 successes and gains a trigger that Stuns on two |!wild|.
The Accelerate Charge superpower was removed (added 2 dice to attack rolls during the next attack action)
The Cards Always Be In My Favor was added
Enhanced Agility changed, Gambit may now advance in any direction instead of Away.
